status: Language question types. Passages are generated as short ORIGINAL texts; no copyrighted passages.

types.title: How a character changes
types.guidance: Ask how a character changes from the beginning to the end, using at least two moments.

types.title: Theme as a full sentence
types.guidance: Ask the student to state a theme as a full sentence (not one word) and prove it.

types.title: Conflict
types.guidance: Ask about the main conflict (internal or external) and how it drives the plot.

types.title: Symbol, foreshadowing or author's craft
types.guidance: Ask what a symbol or foreshadowing hint suggests, and why the author made that choice.

types.title: Point of view and missing voices
types.guidance: Ask how the story would change from another character's view, or whose voice is missing.

types.title: Evaluate a decision
types.guidance: Ask whether a character made a good decision, with reasons and consequences.

types.title: Text-to-world connection
types.guidance: Ask how an idea in the text connects to something in the real world today.

types.title: Poetry: imagery, mood, personification
types.guidance: Provide a short original poem (8-12 lines). Ask about imagery, mood or personification.

types.title: Media literacy: persuasive techniques
types.guidance: Provide a short original advertisement or news item. Ask about persuasive techniques, credibility, or whose voice is missing.
